characters.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE transparent full-body autochess game sprite. Image 1 (sui) and Image 2 (grove_mender) are the ONLY style authorities: match their very thick near-black outline, extremely oversized head (about 65% of total height), tiny stubby body and shoes, mitten hands, broad uninterrupted flat colors, and sparse interior lines. Image 3 is ONLY an identity reference; radically simplify its costume and hair. Three-quarter view facing screen-right, compact upright silhouette. Must be instantly readable at 48 and 64 pixels tall. Use at most 6 major color families plus outline and skin. Hair is 3-5 solid masses with at most 3 inner separation lines; no individual strands. One large simple visible iris per eye with at most ONE white dot, no detailed eyelashes. No gradients or glossy rendering; at most one broad flat shadow per major mass. Plain garments, NO lace, embroidery, mesh, fabric texture, pleats, tiny trim, straps, buckles, dangling accessories, particles, ornamental lines, or patterns. Keep only two or three strongest identity cues and one compact prop. Chunky graphic silhouette is more important than costume accuracy. Single centered character, entire head and feet visible, equal transparent margin, real alpha transparency. No ground, shadow, scene, text, watermark or extra figures. Subject: 小松绿 Viridis. Olive-green bob as a few big rounded shapes, pink eyes, dark brown beret with ONE simple fried-egg shape (white oval/yellow dot); remove ALL flowers. Plain olive vest over white sleeves, plain brown short skirt, dark stubby shoes. Shy expression. Two mitten hands hold ONE simple terracotta pot with a single stem and TWO oversized green leaves. No leaf veins, no other decorations.
